updates.admin.title: Updates
updates.admin.never_checked: Not checked yet: the first check runs a minute after start.
updates.admin.failed: The last check got no answer from GitHub. It tries again tomorrow, or now with Check now.
updates.admin.daily_hint: Reads only the number of the latest version published on GitHub; it sends nothing.
updates.admin.off_env: Turned off for this installation with NUTREEK_UPDATE_CHECK=false.
updates.admin.not_release: This build ({{.Version}}) is not a release, so it does not look for updates.
updates.howto.title: Update to {{.Version}}
updates.howto.intro: Nutreek does not update itself: replacing its own container would need the Docker socket, that is the whole server. Two commands are enough.
updates.howto.backup: Copy the database file, nutreek.db in the data folder, or turn on the automatic backups with NUTREEK_BACKUP_ENABLED=true.
updates.howto.recreate: Then recreate the container with the same volumes. At start Nutreek updates the database by itself.
updates.howto.pinned: If your image is pinned to a version tag, like :v2.0, change it to the new one or to :latest.
updates.build.title: A new version of Nutreek is ready
updates.build.body: The server was updated. Reload when you like: nothing you are typing is lost.
